notes.title: Trenches have been added!
notes.notes:
In the latest update to [i]Victory's Grave: Outflan[/i]k, trench building was added.

Both attackers and defenders can place trenches within their areas of control during the staging phase of combat. This new battlefield obstacle, still in early prototype, already adds new depth to gameplay and strategy. 

[i]Victory's Grave: Outflank[/i] is still in development and available to playtesters by invite only.

Keep following to learn about more upcoming features!
